question: MakeMyTrip SSE-2 / SDE-2 backend technical round 2. **Write code where a producer adds tasks to a bounded queue (waiting when the queue is full) and a consumer processes them in parallel.** (No further detail was reported, so assume Java-style concurrency and a coding-interview setting.)
lookingFor: Understanding of the producer-consumer pattern and blocking.
Correct synchronisation: no lost wakeups, no busy-wait.
Knowing the standard library tool (BlockingQueue) and being able to build it by hand.
Handling shutdown, errors and multiple consumers.
followUps: How would you shut the system down gracefully without losing queued tasks?
What is the difference between ArrayBlockingQueue and LinkedBlockingQueue?
How would you add retry and a dead-letter queue for failing tasks?
